title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba's Qwen AI
summary: China's CAC approved Apple Intelligence for Chinese users powered by Alibaba's Qwen AI, covering iOS/iPadOS/macOS/visionOS. BABA surged ~5-6% in pre-market on the news.
why: Apple与阿里云通义千问深度绑定，利好阿里云AI商业化，同时提振iPhone在华需求；BABA单日+7.65%，持仓影响显著。

title: TSMC Reports 36% Sales Growth as AI Demand Stays Strong
summary: TSMC Q2 2026 revenue $39.62B (+36% YoY), with AI chips now comprising 61% of total sales, validating sustained demand for Nvidia Blackwell/Rubin platforms.
why: 台积电Q2强劲确认AI芯片超级周期，英伟达Vera Rubin产能排期无忧，利好整条AI供应链及相关持仓标的期权溢价。

title: China's GDP expands 4.7% in H1 2026; H2 counter-cyclical stimulus step-up signaled
summary: China NBS: H1 2026 GDP +4.7% YoY (Q1 +5.0%, Q2 +4.3%), foreign trade +16.9%, urban unemployment 5.0%. Officials pledged to deploy incremental stimulus measures at the right moment in H2.
why: Q2增速放缓至4.3%，下半年政策加码信号明确，利好港股/A股消费与科技赛道估值修复，与持仓标的高度契合。

title: ASML raises 2026 guidance second time, beats Q2 earnings on AI chip demand
summary: ASML Q2 2026 net sales EUR 9.3B (beat consensus); full-year 2026 guidance raised for the second time to EUR 43-45B (from EUR 36-40B), driven by AI-related demand for advanced logic and memory equipment.
why: ASML二度上调指引意味着台积电/SK海力士HBM产能扩张超预期，是半导体设备最强领先指标，利好存储和AI芯片整条链。

title: 腾讯秘密开发微信AI智能体，拟三季度全量上线
summary: 腾讯正为微信秘密研发AI智能体（代号Xiaowei），计划Q3 2026向14亿月活用户全量推出，用户可通过语音/文字调用小程序完成支付、订餐等任务；上线节奏取决于监管审批。
why: 微信AI智能体是腾讯下半年最重要催化剂，覆盖14亿用户，有望驱动广告、支付、腾讯云三大业务再上台阶；大摩已将此列为核心超配逻辑。

title: Alibaba (BABA) Stock Forecast July 2026: Four Catalysts Drove 12% in Two Days
summary: BABA surged 12% over two days on four catalysts: $600M DOJ settlement, Pentagon procurement reprieve, narrowing instant-commerce losses, and access to Nvidia H200 chips. Alibaba Cloud grew 38% YoY in Q4 FY2026, with AI products at 30% of external cloud revenue.
why: 法律及监管双重压制解除，AI云基本面持续兑现，BABA估值重估逻辑明确，亦利好阿里云期权链隐含波动率。

title: NVIDIA (NVDA) tests $212: Vera Rubin in production, China shipments resume, Goldman calls P/E 'compelling'
summary: Nvidia stock approached $212 (+4.06%) on July 15 as CEO Jensen Huang confirmed Vera Rubin next-gen AI accelerators are in production and China shipments resumed. Market cap topped $5.1T. Goldman Sachs called the 21.7x forward P/E 'compelling.'
why: Vera Rubin量产时间线明确，中国市场恢复供货，结合TSMC强劲Q2，英伟达数据中心H2超预期概率高，sell put溢价丰厚。

title: Tesla scores best-ever Q2: 480,126 deliveries (+25% YoY), earnings call July 22
summary: Tesla Q2 2026 deliveries: 480,126 vehicles (+25% YoY, beating Wall Street by 74,000) and 13.5 GWh energy storage deployed (+53% QoQ). Q2 financial results call confirmed for July 22 at 5:30PM ET.
why: Q2大幅超预期确立交付反弹趋势，储能业务同步爆发；7月22日财报催化剂在即，TSLA期权隐含波动率料将抬升。

title: Circle gets OCC federal bank charter — first stablecoin issuer with US federal trust license
summary: Circle received OCC approval on July 10 to establish First National Digital Currency Bank, becoming the world's first stablecoin issuer with a US federal trust bank charter. CRCL shares surged 14% on the news. Coinbase+BlackRock's Open USD now challenges USDC market share.
why: OCC联邦银行牌照是稳定币合规里程碑，大幅提升USDC储备信用等级，利好Circle估值重估；GENIUS Act 7月18日截止将进一步强化护城河。

title: A July rate hike from the Fed? The odds are rising to 46.5%
summary: CME FedWatch shows 46.5% probability of a 25bp hike at the July 29 FOMC meeting (up from ~25%), as US CPI stands at 4.2% YoY. Fed Chair Warsh is pushing a data-dependent, forward-guidance-light approach.
why: 加息概率升至近50%将抬升期权隐含波动率，对sell put策略的行权价设置和到期日选择有直接含义；成长股估值承压。

title: U.S.-Iran escalation weighs on bitcoin, stocks as oil climbs
summary: Bitcoin fell to ~$62,600 as US-Iran tensions drove risk-off moves and lifted oil prices. Bitcoin ETF outflows exceeded $84M in recent sessions; BTC tests support under $63K ahead of July 29 FOMC.
why: 地缘风险叠加Fed鹰派，BTC承压，Circle(USDC)及加密相关标的情绪短期受压；油价上涨可能加剧通胀，进一步支持加息预期。

title: 我国经济半年报出炉：新质生产力表现亮眼，下半年政策调节力度或将加码
summary: 中国上半年新质生产力（高端制造、数字经济）贡献超40%增量，政策层面确认下半年将适时加码逆周期政策，重点支持科技创新与消费升级。
why: 政策加码信号利好港股/A股消费与科技双赛道，与持仓的腾讯、阿里、泡泡玛特等核心标的高度契合。

title: Tesla expands Robotaxi service to Miami — first city outside Texas
summary: Tesla rolled out its unsupervised Cybercab robotaxi service in a geofenced area of West Miami on July 14, the first expansion beyond Texas. Florida's rain is a key stress test for Tesla's camera-only FSD system.
why: Robotaxi跨州扩张标志FSD商业化加速，是TSLA从汽车公司向AI出行平台重估的关键里程碑；7月22日财报前持续催化。

title: Google delays Gemini 3.5 Pro to July 17 after full rebuild; DeepMind talent exodus deepens
summary: Google DeepMind rebuilt Gemini 3.5 Pro from scratch on a Gemini 3 foundation targeting July 17 launch with a 2M-token context window, after structural failures were found in the 2.5 Pro architecture. Alphabet lost ~$225B in market cap amid four senior DeepMind departures.
why: Gemini 3.5 Pro明日（7月17日）即将发布，若表现强劲将提振谷歌搜索广告护城河；DeepMind人才流失是中长期估值风险点。

title: SK Hynix (SKHY) surges 27% then consolidates; Barclays initiates Outperform at $330; HBM4 ships for Nvidia Vera Rubin
summary: SK Hynix Korean shares jumped ~13.4% on July 15; US ADR SKHY hit $193 after surging 27% on July 14, then consolidated at ~$186. Barclays initiated with Outperform/$330 target. DRAM supply meets only 75-80% of demand; HBM4 now shipping for Nvidia Vera Rubin.
why: HBM4量产超预期，供应缺口结构性存在，巴克莱$330目标价隐含大幅上涨空间；SKHY ADR是卖put高溢价优质标的。

title: Micron Q3 FY2026: Revenue +346% YoY, HBM4 in production for Nvidia Vera Rubin; 2026 capacity sold out
summary: Micron Q3 FY2026 revenue $41.456B (+346% YoY); HBM4 entered production and is shipping to Nvidia for Vera Rubin platform; all 2026 HBM capacity is sold out. Stock near $989-995; analyst consensus target $1,486.
why: 全年HBM产能售罄锁定业绩确定性，HBM4为英伟达Rubin供货确认存储超级周期；MU是sell put的优质高溢价标的。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) drops 5.71%: Argus 'Hold' rating, NAND competition fears; bulls target $3,000 year-end
summary: SanDisk fell 5.71% on July 15 after Argus Research started with a 'Hold' (not Buy); NAND prices declining faster than expected amid Chinese competition. Motley Fool argues BiCS10 tech leads peers by 59% density plus Meta multi-year supply deal supports a $3,000 year-end target.
why: SNDK年内涨逾800%后多空激烈博弈，NAND价格走势是卖put安全边际的核心变量；8月5日财报是关键看清节点。

title: GENIUS Act countdown: Stablecoin rules deadline July 18 — six US federal agencies on the clock
summary: Six US federal agencies face a July 18 statutory deadline to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules. USDC already substantially meets compliance requirements; Circle expected to be the first issuer to receive formal PPSI designation.
why: 后天（7月18日）是USDC合规化关键时间节点，规则落地将为机构采用扫清障碍，是CRCL股价近期最重要催化剂。

title: Palantir (PLTR) +24% in July on Nvidia sovereign AI partnership; consensus Buy at $187
summary: Palantir shares surged ~24% in July to $133.75, driven by an expanded Nvidia partnership deploying Nemotron AI models in classified, air-gapped US government environments via AIP/Foundry/Apollo. Q1 2026 revenue $1.633B (+85% YoY); consensus Buy, avg target $187.42.
why: 国防AI合同壁垒高、波动率特征稳定，PLTR是sell put策略优质标的；与英伟达协同将进一步拓宽政府合同护城河。

title: 盈透证券新增12种加密代币交易；6月DARTs同比+53%创历史新高
summary: 盈透证券（IBKR）7月14日新增12种加密代币（含Aave、Aptos、Uniswap等）及稳定币出金功能；2026年6月DARTs达526.9万笔（+53% YoY，+6% MoM），客户权益与保证金余额双创纪录；Q2财报定于7月21日收市后发布。
why: 加密业务扩展+DARTs历史新高显示业务势头强劲，7月21日财报催化剂临近；H1股价+35.3%后财报超预期概率高，期权布局值得关注。

title: Xiaomi delivers 30,000+ EVs in July (record); YU7 waitlist extends to H2 2026; new SU7 to launch this month
summary: Xiaomi EV deliveries surpassed 30,000 in July for the first time (new monthly record). YU7 SUV demand far exceeds capacity with new orders stretching into H2. CEO Lei Jun announced a new-generation SU7 will be officially released this month with large-scale deliveries to follow.
why: 产能与交付双超预期，YU7订单积压转为确定性收入，新SU7本月发布将是1810.HK股价催化剂，可考虑财报前期权布局。

title: Billionaire Duan Yongping increases Pop Mart stake to 7.65% — third purchase, approaching 8% threshold
summary: Chinese-American billionaire Duan Yongping raised his Pop Mart stake from 6.85% to 7.65% on July 6 in his third consecutive purchase, now approaching the 8% mandatory disclosure threshold, signaling strong conviction in Labubu's global momentum.
why: 段永平三度增持至距8%通报阈值仅一步，下次增持需正式披露；叠加NYC展览/FIFA联名等里程碑事件，Labubu出海势头持续，9992.HK上行催化充足。

title: Intel (INTC): 18A-P enters risk production, $100 support holds ahead of July 23 earnings
summary: Intel's 18A-P process (9% performance improvement over base 18A, yield improved from 65% to 85%) entered risk production in June. Stock held ~$100 support on July 15. Q2 earnings due July 23; Gaudi 3 enterprise adoption still lags Nvidia.
why: 7月23日财报是18A代工业务信用重建的关键节点，若Gaudi 3获突破性采购将是重大超预期事件；当前$100支撑是关键风险观察点。

title: TAL Education to release Q1 FY2027 financial results on July 30
summary: TAL Education Group will report Q1 FY2027 results (period ended May 31, 2026) before US market open on July 30. Prior quarter net profit grew 174% YoY; AI courseware and smart learning devices are scaling, with offline learning center openings up 60% YoY.
why: 7月30日财报倒计时，上季净利润+174%设定高期望基数，AI教育硬件加速商业化；财报前可评估期权策略。

title: Costco June net sales +10.6% YoY to $29.24B; declares $1.47 quarterly dividend
summary: Costco June 2026 (five weeks ended July 5): net sales $29.24B (+10.6% YoY); comparable sales +8.8%; digitally-enabled sales +20.9%. Board declared $1.47/share quarterly dividend payable August 7. Stock fell ~1.2% AH as comps decelerated from May's +12.5%.
why: 可比店销售增速较5月下滑引发消费降速担忧，但会员制基本面稳健；派息信号盈利信心足，COST短期期权隐含波动率偏低适合卖put。
